text.name: text
text.default: 'Prophetess Hannah Okoh dedicated much of her life to caring for the less privileged. During festive seasons, she visited orphanages and underserved communities, making sure children and families received food, clothing and essential support.'

closing.name: closing
closing.default: 'Her legacy of compassion lives on through St. Hannah Foundation.'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Watch the work through the lives of the people and communities we serve.'

description.default: 'Every photograph records a life touched and a community strengthened. Browse the work by programme area, or open the full gallery.'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Every initiative, every outreach and every act of generosity contributes to building stronger families, restoring dignity and creating opportunities for individuals and communities to thrive.'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Every programme begins with someone''s real circumstances. This is one of them, told in full.'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Behind every program is a story of resilience, hope and lives being transformed through compassion and support.'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Every act of kindness creates opportunities for children, strengthens families and restores hope to communities. Whether you choose to give, volunteer or partner with us, you become part of a mission that changes lives every day.'
